name: network_audit
description: Audits the network this machine is attached to: interfaces, routes and gateways, listening sockets, the ARP table, parallel host discovery on a subnet, parallel port scanning with service identification, a TLS handshake audit (protocol versions, cipher suites, certificate chain and expiry), an HTTP security-header audit, Wi-Fi and BLE beacon sweep, ARP-spoofing detection and a VPN-leak check. Read-only by default; anything that contacts a named target is gated by core/tool_policy.py and names its target. Never scans a network the caller did not name.

operation.description: One of: tools | interfaces | listeners | arp | subnet_scan | port_scan | wifi_scan | ble_scan | tls_audit | header_audit | arp_spoof | vpn_leak | latency | sources. Defaults to tools.

target.description: Host, domain or IP for the tls/header audits, e.g. example.com. Required by tls_audit and header_audit.

network.description: CIDR or dotted-quad base for subnet_scan, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Defaults to this machine's /24.

ports.description: Port list for port_scan: 'common', a comma list, or a range like 1-1024. Defaults to common.

host.description: Host for port_scan. Defaults to the named target, or a discovered host.

authorized.description: Must be true to run an operation that contacts a target (subnet_scan, port_scan, tls/header audits). Read-only local operations never need it.

confirm.description: Must be true to start an operation that contacts a target.

timeout.description: Per-probe timeout in seconds. Defaults to 1.0 for scans, 8 for audits.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 50.

author: Stella
notes: Local reads use psutil/socket; scanning is bounded and parallel with a stated cap. Operations that contact a target are active class in core/tool_policy.py.
